title: Neuro Rivals
scoreType: Independent graphics/gameplay rubric; not stars or an external user rating
observed: Used actual Race menu then Start race, with normal ArrowUp/Left/Right and Space input.
Active 6-car race HUD advanced from 3.683 to 14.683 seconds; speed and positions changed; no score/time/model injection.

Clean high-contrast 2D top-down presentation, distinguishable car colours, tyre marks, minimap and timing/standings. The circuit environment and car silhouettes are simpler than the strongest 3D candidates.
Menu exposed five named tracks, championship, time trial, training lab, track editor and garage/settings.
sourceSupportedNotFullyPlayed: Race.ts has standings, collision resolution, lap timing, ghost-recording and finished-state logic; a complete race/season was not played.
README/source describe neural-network rival training, trained difficulty tiers, player chassis, achievements and custom tracks; only normal race driving was exercised.
assessment: Strong gameplay variety and approachable controls; visual clarity is good, but scenery/vehicle detail is modest. Good fallback if visual leaders cannot be packaged, not automatically a top-nine pick on graphics.

packaging.externalAssets: Original procedural graphics and synthesised sound; Vite/TypeScript build dependencies need pinning.
packaging.controllerWork: Map driving/nitro/pause and all menu focus, adapt track editor cursor/actions or clearly separate optional editor; keep offline records/ghosts/rival storage.
packaging.status: Feasible, not yet adapted or packaged

limits: Live demo version is not proven equal to the fixed source commit; source snapshots and live screenshots are separate evidence.
